answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil swarms with bond-escrowed identity: each new agent must post a slashable stake and solve a verifiable attestation whose answer is a one-time cipher derived from the epoch seed, so fresh identities cannot be minted for free or farmed from an earlier grove of aliases. Creating N agents costs N bonds, and any cluster shown to share a controller or replay an attestation is slashed, so attacker spend scales linearly while exit on the horizon stays locked until the bond matures.
